description: This file defines the MonkeyEventSource interface, which specifies methods for event sources in the Android Monkey testing framework, such as retrieving the next event, setting verbosity level, and validating preconditions.

classes.name: MonkeyEventSource
classes.description: Interface for event sources in the Monkey testing framework, providing methods to retrieve events, set verbosity, and validate the source.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Returns the next MonkeyEvent from this source.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for logging. 'verbose' parameter controls the level: 1= verbose, 2=very verbose.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the preconditions for event sourcing are satisfied. Returns false if the source cannot produce events properly.
